- Dates and status
  - Held 27–31 July 2019 (5 stages) across Wallonia, Belgium.
  - UCI Europe Tour category 2.HC.

- Overall outcome
  - General classification winner: Loïc Vliegen (Wanty–Gobert Cycling Team). He moved into the lead on the Ardennes hills late in the race and defended it to the finish.

  - Arnaud Démare (Groupama–FDJ) won early flat/rolling stages with reduced-bunch sprints.
  - Loïc Vliegen won a decisive hilly stage in the Ardennes to seize GC control.
  - Giacomo Nizzolo (Dimension Data) won one of the late sprint stages.
  - Lionel Taminiaux (Wallonie–Bruxelles) also snagged a stage from a break/small group.

- Teams
  - WorldTeams present included Deceuninck–Quick-Step, Lotto Soudal, Groupama–FDJ, and Team Dimension Data.
  - Strong Belgian Pro Continental presence: Wanty–Gobert (the winning team), Wallonie–Bruxelles, Sport Vlaanderen–Baloise, plus several other Pro Continental and Continental squads.

- Route character
  - A mix of Walloon terrains: flat-to-rolling roads in Hainaut and Liège provinces early on, then punchy Ardennes climbs deciding GC late.
  - Typical finishes included uphill drags and technical approaches favoring positioning and late attacks.

Notes on certainty
